max_size.description: Maximum size of a log file before it is rotated (e.g. '100m', '1g'). Corresponds to log-opts max-size in daemon.json.

max_file.description: Maximum number of rotated log files to keep (e.g. '3', '10'). Corresponds to log-opts max-file in daemon.json.

restart_docker.description: If true, docker daemon will be restarted.

disable_reboot_request.description: If true, LCM reboot request file creation will be skipped.
